_rule: Frozen baseline of hand-stamped color literals that the theme compiler did NOT emit. design/check.mjs Part E re-counts each file and FAILS on ANY drift from `count` — growth (a new literal) OR shrink (a literal was tokenized). A ratchet: every change to a file's literal count MUST update its baseline in THIS SAME DIFF. The ledger only shrinks over time; it can never silently grow. Counting rule lives next to the implementation in design/check.mjs Part E (LEDGER_LITERAL regex + stripLedgerNoise): a color literal is `#hex` (3-8 digits) or an rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() whose first argument is NOT var() — `hsl(var(--x))` is compiler-driven token consumption, not a hand-stamp, so it is excluded (this is what lets a literal→var conversion register as a shrink). Marker regions — ANY `BEGIN/END GENERATED: <name>` block, i.e. `tokens` (design/emit.mjs), `paper-surface` (the reader→editor mirror), and `status-tones` (the status skin) — and comments (CSS /* */, HTML <!-- -->, HEEx <%!-- --%> and <%# %>) are blanked before counting, so generator-emitted literals and e.g. the `#940` PR-ref in app.css never count as hand-stamps.
_note: The per-file `count` splits as {hex + literal-rgb/rgba + literal-hsl}. These are the surfaces still holding hand-stamped color the theme-system compiler has not yet reached; as tokenization lands, LOWER the number here in the same diff.

_retired.why: REMOVED, not raised. Part E's counting rule cannot apply to this path, so its number never measured hand-stamps. The file is the MINIFIED build of api/assets/paper-editor/src/styles.css: esbuild strips comments, so the bundle carries 0 `BEGIN/END GENERATED` markers (the source carries 1) and stripLedgerNoise() blanks nothing — every literal design/emit.mjs emitted is counted as a hand-stamp. Measured at a0c52917da: of the 69 distinct hex values the file gained in 0ceefc5911 (#14397, the vendor resync), 69 of 69 sit inside the source's BEGIN/END GENERATED span and 0 are orphans; before that commit the bundle carried ZERO `[data-bp-theme]` blocks and after it carries all five (charple/ember/evergreen/fjord/iris). The +132 that reddened main WAS the N-theme identity layer arriving in a copy that had missed it for months — which also means the count is a function of THEME COUNT, so theme #6 would red Part E again for no design reason. That is what trains people to bump a baseline, and bumping is the one thing this ratchet exists to prevent.
_retired.coverage_is_not_lost: The bundle's genuine hand-stamped residue is already ratcheted at its SOURCE — the api/assets/paper-editor/src/styles.css entry below (count 57), whose markers are intact, so the blanking rule works there. Byte-integrity of the built artifact is pinned by api/test/barkpark/paper_editor_vendor_drift_test.exs, which byte-compares web/public/assets/bp-paper-editor.css against api/priv/static/assets/bp-paper-editor.css and runs under the REQUIRED `Elixir gate`. A byte pin is strictly stronger than a literal count, and it covers BOTH legs of the pair — this ledger only ever watched one (api/priv/static/assets/bp-paper-editor.css was never an entry).
_retired.reinstate_if: the bundle ever ships UNMINIFIED, or the build learns to preserve the BEGIN/END GENERATED markers. Then the blanking rule fires again and a count here means what it says.
